note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 and @1.39.0 (each with its @effect-dynamodb/schema and effect@4.1.2), installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local: never regenerate or "fix" it. An aggregate's `many` edge (no `entity:`, sort key `qty`) whose element schema shows no fields of its own (helpers/AggregateWholeElements.ts): a union whose second member renames a field (`line` stored, `text` held) given its domain value and its stored form, the same on a sub-aggregate bound with `side: 1`, a struct through `Schema.encodeKeys({ text: "line" })` given either form, a struct decoded to another, a union member holding a `Schema.NumberFromString`, and a `Schema.NullOr` struct holding a `Schema.DateTimeUtcFromString`. Per shape: `create`'s outcome, its requests (the table name as <table>) and the partition's rows (by sort key), `get`, a no-op `update`'s requests, an `update` setting the root's title with its requests and rows, and `get` after it.
